steps.subject: retail and distribution buyers
steps.body:
Hi,

Are you {looking to add|trying to add|hoping to add} retail or distribution accounts for your products?

Dulcy handles B2B prospect research, verified {prospect lists|lists of prospects|buyer lists} and outreach. The idea is to {put|get} your products in front of buyers {in the markets you want to reach|in the markets you're looking to reach}.

Worth a {short conversation|quick conversation|brief chat} about whether that fits your sales plans?

Hi,

One way to keep this focused is to {start with|begin with|focus on} a product category, target territory and buyer type.

Those would {guide|shape|inform} the prospect list and outreach, alongside any channel restrictions you need to preserve.

Is there one product category you want to {put first|prioritize|start with}?

Hi,

The decision is simply whether {targeted outreach to retail or distribution buyers|direct outreach to retail or distribution buyers|outreach to retail or distribution buyers} is worth exploring for your products.

{If it is|If so|If that makes sense}, which market {would you want to reach first|would you want to target first|would you want to start with}?
